eggplan [--state-root PATH] [--json] COMMAND
init - create a state root
new - create a plan from a definition
list - compact, bounded plan overview
show ARG - one plan with its items
status [ARG ...] - plan status summary
ready ARG - ready-to-execute items
graph ARG - dependency graph
check [ARG] - read-only integrity and readiness check
activate ARG - activate a draft plan
item SUBCOMMAND ARG ARG - update a plan item
evidence SUBCOMMAND ARG - inspect the evidence ledger
assess ARG - assess a plan against a policy
close ARG - guarded closure
closure SUBCOMMAND ARG - show a closure record
registry SUBCOMMAND - render the plan registry
markdown SUBCOMMAND ARG - Markdown interchange
completions SUBCOMMAND - print a shell completion script to stdout
help [ARG] - show usage
